description:
Fired when the Admin API is about to return the values of options or config.php settings. Lets an add-on say which of its own settings are secrets, so that the rest can be shown.

Until an add-on declares its secrets here, the Admin API returns only whether each of its text settings is set. Declaring an empty list is still a declaration: it says the add-on has none.

Callback signature:

array &$declarations

Arguments:

  1. array &$declarations - Add an entry keyed by your add-on id, with either or both of:
    • options - a list of the options that are secrets, each as optionId, or optionId.member for one member of an array option.
    • config - an array of the top-level config.php keys your add-on reads, each with a list of the dotted keys under it that are secrets.

Example:

$declarations['Vendor/AddOn'] = [
    'options' => ['vendorApiKey', 'vendorService.password'],
    'config' => ['vendorAddOn' => ['vendorAddOn.secret']],
];

Settings whose names or values look like credentials are withheld whatever is declared. Declare your own add-on only.
